scope: Architecture responsibilities and documentation only. Production RTL, ISA, pipeline cycles and experimental overlays remain unchanged. Hardware access/programming is prohibited in this task.
decisions: Adopt the three control layers: global mode, cross-stage arbitration, and stage-local responsibilities.
Keep datapath_core as its historical RTL name; describe it as the complete execution core containing both datapath and hardwired pipeline control.
CW_X/M/W are documented sets of existing scalar fields, not new physical buses, controller modules or state.
Preserve one RF, one architectural flags register, four logical boundaries and one-cycle synchronous IM/DM. Observation shadows never feed execution.
Retain default AC1 and both isolated experiments. Do not combine cycle-preserving document reorganization with WB-to-MEM adoption.
Do not extract new RTL modules without a demonstrated ownership/interface defect. Current signal owners are unique; internal TB/mutation seams make unmotivated extraction costly.
Preserve historical reports and tests. Regenerate current-source independent48 traces for the five worked examples; do not claim a new nine-suite or P&R run.
Unconfirmed-target programming attempts are not EES-331 evidence. Physical validation is deferred by the user.
